sourceReview.detail: Subdivision A ends at 2415112 and B starts at 2415114; ID 2415113 is not covered by either. Verify against the official list.

Source prints group 3 and 3B as '2415149 – الأخر' / '2415185 – الأخر' (to the end). The upper bound is set to the ceiling of this cohort's 4-digit seat prefix (2415xxx -> 2415999) so the range cannot bleed into another cohort's namespace (e.g. Clinical 2510xxx), which previously made every clinical ID match both cohorts and raised AmbiguousAssignmentError on ID lookup.

IDs 2435001 and 2435002 (listed in the ChemSketch 3B-4 batch) sit in the 2435xxx prefix, outside 2415xxx, so they no longer auto-resolve to group 3 B and will report 'not found'. If the college confirms they belong to PharmD Year 3 group 3 B, add them as explicit overrides rather than widening this range.
